findings.title: getForLogin cache is not invalidated on organization changes
findings.body: Unlike getByOrganization (line 173), which checks `isInvalid(orgId)` in addition to its own cache key, getForLogin only checks `isInvalid(cacheKey)`. Removing/disabling an organization, or changing an organization's identity-provider membership through the organization provider (which invalidates the organization id, not the `.idp.login.*` keys), will leave the ORG_ONLY/ALL login caches populated with stale IDP id sets. Consumers that call getForLogin and don't re-check `isEnabled()` (the wrapper only hides disabled orgs, not removed org links) will see providers that should no longer be offered for login. Consider also checking `isInvalid(organizationId)` and registering login-cache invalidations in the organization provider.

findings.title: getLoginPredicate semantics changed for org-linked IDPs
findings.body: `getLoginPredicate()` now additionally rejects any IDP that has an organizationId unless its config has BROKER_PUBLIC=true. This is a public SPI helper that may be used by callers other than the new invalidation logic (e.g. bean/federated-provider filtering); for them, non-public organization brokers will silently disappear from results. If the restriction is only needed for cache invalidation, it should be a separate predicate, or the behavior change should be documented in the method javadoc.

findings.title: remove() always issues an extra DB lookup by alias
findings.body: `idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias)` is now executed unconditionally in `remove()`, even when the entry is present (and valid) in the cache, where previously the cached model was used. This adds a database round-trip to every IDP removal. The stored model could be obtained from the cached entry in the else-branch instead.

findings.title: Test cleanup registers the literal alias "alias" so created IDPs are never removed
findings.body: `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove)` uses the hard-coded string "alias" rather than the created provider's alias (`idp-alias-N`). None of the 21 identity providers created by testCacheIDPForLogin are deleted after the test, and the cleanup call itself will fail/404. This leaks state into other tests in the realm (same bug is repeated at lines 303 and 425).
